scenario: Bust-out velocity (5 apps/7d, 9/30d) with elevated loan-to-income
why_this_fixture_exists: Velocity plus exposure with no identity manipulation. Also the staffing-agency control: the employer carries 260 SSNs and 40 new in 90 days, and EMP-017 names staffing agencies explicitly as NOT a fraud signal, so the employment domain must clear independently even though the application is MEDIUM overall.
synthetic_data_notice: SYNTHETIC DEMO RECORD. Fictional borrower, dealer and employer. No real PII. The SSN is carried only as hash_ssn (General Rule 23: never surface a raw SSN).

ssn_distinct_identity_combinations_conte.customer_interpretation: ssn_distinct_identity_combinations = 1 is NORMAL. >1 with different DOBs or names is concerning.
ssn_distinct_identity_combinations_conte.example_rows: 1 combination on this hash_ssn: PAT MORALES / 1987-04-xx, seen on 2 prior applications with the same normalized first name, last name and DOB.

phone_reuse_distinct_ssn_count_context.customer_interpretation: phone_reuse_distinct_ssn_count: 1-2 is normal (shared household). 3+ with new SSNs in 90d warrants investigation.
phone_reuse_distinct_ssn_count_context.example_rows: Normalized phone matches 2 hash_ssn values: the borrower and one other sharing her surname and address.

email_reuse_distinct_ssn_count_context.customer_interpretation: email_reuse_distinct_ssn_count: 1 is normal. 2+ requires context validation (family vs. fraud).
email_reuse_distinct_ssn_count_context.example_rows: Normalized email matches 1 hash_ssn - this borrower only. Not present in the fake-email source.

address_reuse_distinct_ssn_count_context.customer_interpretation: address_reuse_distinct_ssn_count: varies by property type. Multi-unit or dense areas can have high counts normally. Check is_multi_unit_address.
address_reuse_distinct_ssn_count_context.example_rows: Address key resolves to 2 hash_ssn values, same surname, same unit, both present for 3 years.

is_multi_unit_address_context.customer_interpretation: address_reuse_distinct_ssn_count: varies by property type. Multi-unit or dense areas can have high counts normally. Check is_multi_unit_address.
is_multi_unit_address_context.example_rows: Property type on file is single-family detached; no unit or apartment token parsed from the street address.

ssn_days_in_system_context.customer_interpretation: ssn_days_in_system = 0 (new to system): common for first-time buyers. Only concerning with other velocity signals.
ssn_days_in_system_context.example_rows: First consortium sighting 1,400 days ago; 6 applications since, all with the same name, DOB and address key.

inquiries_in_2weeks_context.customer_interpretation: It's also useful to look at cases where the borrower's credit score is quite high (i.e. greater than or equal to 650) and has more than 4 credit inquiries (based on the inquiries_in_2weeks field), this is also often at risk of identity fraud.
inquiries_in_2weeks_context.example_rows: 7 inquiries in the trailing 14 days. Credit score 649, just below the 650 threshold the identity instructions pair with high inquiry counts.

dealer_consortium_score_context.customer_interpretation: dealer_consortium_score: 0-500 low, 500-700 moderate, 700-900 elevated, 900+ high. Reflects overall portfolio performance, NOT fraud participation.
dealer_consortium_score_context.example_rows: Dealer scored 710 this month; 690-725 across the trailing 12 months. Elevated band, flat trend.

dealer_risk_score_context.customer_interpretation: 21. There are two scores that measure dealer risk. The scores are dealer_risk_score and dealer_consortium_score. The dealer_risk_score is the numerical representation of the dealer risk within a particular lender's portfolio. Meanwhile, the dealer_consortium_score is the aggregated risk of that dealer amongst all lenders in the Point Predictive Consortium.

dealer_lender_default_rate_context.customer_interpretation: dealer_lender_default_rate: High rates indicate poor credit quality at this dealer. Only fraud-relevant if combined with coordinated patterns.
dealer_lender_default_rate_context.example_rows: 12 defaults across 132 funded loans for this dealer with this lender.

dealer_consortium_epd_rate_last_24mo_con.customer_interpretation: dealer_consortium_epd_rate_last_24mo: Early payment default rate. Credit indicator, not fraud indicator unless unusually concentrated.
dealer_consortium_epd_rate_last_24mo_con.example_rows: 128 early payment defaults across 1,600 consortium applications in 24 months.

phone_reuse_count_this_dealer_context.customer_interpretation: phone_reuse_count_this_dealer: Borrowers sharing phones at same dealer. 0-1 is normal. 2+ with high fraud scores is concerning for coordination.
phone_reuse_count_this_dealer_context.example_rows: 1 other borrower at this dealer shares this phone: the household member above.

employer_concentration_pct_context.customer_interpretation: employer_concentration_pct: High concentration of same employer at a dealer. Normal for dealers near large employers/bases. >20% at small dealers with few apps is more concerning.
employer_concentration_pct_context.example_rows: Top employer at this dealer accounts for 58 of 1,450 applications (4.0%); this borrower's employer accounts for 11.

ssn_previous_apps_all_time_context.customer_interpretation: ssn_previous_apps_all_time / ssn_previous_apps_90d: Borrower repeat activity. Normal for rate-shopping. Concerning only if combined with EPD/default history.
ssn_previous_apps_all_time_context.example_rows: 6 prior applications on this hash_ssn over 46 months. No EPD, no 999, 2 funded and current.

ssn_previous_apps_90d_context.customer_interpretation: ssn_previous_apps_all_time / ssn_previous_apps_90d: Borrower repeat activity. Normal for rate-shopping. Concerning only if combined with EPD/default history.
ssn_previous_apps_90d_context.example_rows: 9 prior applications in the trailing 90 days - 8 of them inside the last 30 days, at 6 dealers within a 40-mile radius.

previous_epd_count_context.customer_interpretation: previous_epd_count / previous_999_count: Prior bad outcomes. Relevant to individual borrower risk, not dealer fraud unless a dealer pattern.
previous_epd_count_context.example_rows: 0 early payment defaults across the 2 prior applications for this hash_ssn.

previous_999_count_context.customer_interpretation: previous_epd_count / previous_999_count: Prior bad outcomes. Relevant to individual borrower risk, not dealer fraud unless a dealer pattern.
previous_999_count_context.example_rows: No prior application for this hash_ssn carried a fraud score of 999; prior scores were 168 and 205.

borr_ssn_in_negative_file_context.customer_interpretation: borr_ssn_in_negative_file / borr_ssn_linked_to_synthetic_fraud: Individual borrower flags. Dealer fraud only if multiple such borrowers cluster at one dealer.
borr_ssn_in_negative_file_context.example_rows: hash_ssn is not present in the negative file; 0 matching entries across all contributing lenders.

borr_ssn_linked_to_synthetic_fraud_conte.customer_interpretation: borr_ssn_in_negative_file / borr_ssn_linked_to_synthetic_fraud: Individual borrower flags. Dealer fraud only if multiple such borrowers cluster at one dealer.
borr_ssn_linked_to_synthetic_fraud_conte.example_rows: 0 confirmed synthetic-fraud records are linked to this hash_ssn across 2 prior funded loans.

dealer_app_volume_24mo_context.customer_interpretation: High-volume dealers (1000+ apps/24mo) naturally have higher absolute counts of everything — normalize mentally by volume.
dealer_app_volume_24mo_context.example_rows: 1,600 consortium applications in 24 months; consortium_number_of_apps_last_1_year is 760, so the dealer is active.

dealer_apps_last_7d_context.example_rows: 13 applications at this dealer in the last 7 days: 13 distinct hash_ssn values, 12 distinct phones, 13 distinct addresses.

has_coborrower_context.customer_interpretation: No co-borrower present: Primary straw mechanism absent. Only evaluate if other patterns (role-switching history, dealer clustering) exist.
has_coborrower_context.example_rows: No co-borrower on this application. coborrower source tables return no row for this (application_id, hash_lender_id).

coborrower_appears_as_borrower_count_con.customer_interpretation: coborrower_appears_as_borrower_count or borrower_appears_as_coborrower_count > 0: Role switching. Concerning with non-family relationships or high frequency.
coborrower_appears_as_borrower_count_con.example_rows: No co-borrower on this application, so there are 0 co-borrower role records to compare - an absence of a party, not a party with 0 switches.

borrower_appears_as_coborrower_count_con.customer_interpretation: coborrower_appears_as_borrower_count or borrower_appears_as_coborrower_count > 0: Role switching. Concerning with non-family relationships or high frequency.
borrower_appears_as_coborrower_count_con.example_rows: 0 consortium applications carry this hash_ssn as a co-borrower.

coborr_distinct_primary_borrowers_count_.customer_interpretation: coborr_distinct_primary_borrowers_count: 1-2 is normal (family). 3+ with different dealers is concerning.
coborr_distinct_primary_borrowers_count_.example_rows: No co-borrower on this application, so 0 primary borrowers are linked through one.

credit_score_gap_context.customer_interpretation: credit_score_gap > 100: Possible credit piggybacking. Evaluate with relationship type and income proportion.
credit_score_gap_context.example_rows: No co-borrower, so no second credit score to compare against 704.

coborr_income_70_percent_plus_context.customer_interpretation: coborr_income_70_percent_plus: Co-borrower carries most income — possible indicator but common in spousal relationships.
coborr_income_70_percent_plus_context.example_rows: No co-borrower income on file, so the co-borrower share of combined income is 0%.

coborr_3_plus_apps_same_dealer_flag_cont.customer_interpretation: coborr_3_plus_apps_same_dealer_flag: Concerning for dealer-coordinated straw activity.
coborr_3_plus_apps_same_dealer_flag_cont.example_rows: No co-borrower, so 0 co-borrower applications exist at this or any dealer.

high_value_vehicle_weak_profile_straw_ri.customer_interpretation: high_value_vehicle_weak_profile_straw_risk: Only concerning with OTHER corroborating straw patterns.
high_value_vehicle_weak_profile_straw_ri.example_rows: Vehicle is mid-market and the loan is 0.38x annual income; profile and collateral are proportionate.

employer_distinct_other_ssns_count_conte.customer_interpretation: employer_distinct_other_ssns_count: Varies by employer size. Large employers (100+ SSNs) are normal. Small employer with rapid new SSN growth in 90d is more concerning.
employer_distinct_other_ssns_count_conte.example_rows: 260 distinct hash_ssn values cite Contract Staffing Partners over 5 years. The employer is a licensed staffing agency with a verifiable address, city, state, ZIP and listed line.

employer_new_ssns_90d_context.customer_interpretation: employer_new_ssns_90d: High count at a previously quiet employer suggests potential shell/fabricated employer. Contextualize with employer size.
employer_new_ssns_90d_context.example_rows: 40 new hash_ssn values cited this employer in the last 90 days against 260 all-time. A staffing agency's roster turns over continuously; its trailing 4 quarters added 36, 44, 31 and 40.

employer_phone_distinct_ssn_count_contex.customer_interpretation: employer_phone_distinct_ssn_count: Shared employer phone is normal for businesses. Only concerning if the phone is also a personal cell number.
employer_phone_distinct_ssn_count_contex.example_rows: 260 hash_ssn values share 614-555-0130, the agency's published main line.

rapid_employer_change_flag_context.customer_interpretation: rapid_employer_change_flag: Multiple employer changes in short windows. Consider career transitions, contract work, seasonal employment, or staffing agencies as normal explanations.
rapid_employer_change_flag_context.example_rows: 2 employers cited across 60 days, both staffing placements: the agency itself and a prior agency assignment that ended 51 days ago.

employer_spike_flag_context.customer_interpretation: employer_spike_flag: Sudden increase in applications citing this employer. May reflect hiring surge, not fraud.
employer_spike_flag_context.example_rows: Monthly applications citing this employer: 12, 15, 11, 14, 13, 16 over the last 6 months. The 90-day count is flat, not a spike from a quiet base.

ssn_distinct_employers_all_time_context.customer_interpretation: ssn_distinct_employers_all_time vs ssn_distinct_employers_30d/60d: High all-time with low recent is normal career history. High recent count is velocity concern.
ssn_distinct_employers_all_time_context.example_rows: 5 employers all-time over 46 months, 3 of them staffing agencies - normal career history for contract work.

ssn_distinct_employers_30d_context.customer_interpretation: ssn_distinct_employers_all_time vs ssn_distinct_employers_30d/60d: High all-time with low recent is normal career history. High recent count is velocity concern.
ssn_distinct_employers_30d_context.example_rows: 1 employer cited in the trailing 30 days.

ssn_distinct_employers_60d_context.customer_interpretation: ssn_distinct_employers_all_time vs ssn_distinct_employers_30d/60d: High all-time with low recent is normal career history. High recent count is velocity concern.
ssn_distinct_employers_60d_context.example_rows: 2 employers cited in the trailing 60 days, both staffing assignments.

ssn_distinct_income_amounts_all_time_con.customer_interpretation: ssn_distinct_income_amounts_all_time: 1-2 is normal (job changes, raises). 3+ with short timeframes is concerning.
ssn_distinct_income_amounts_all_time_con.example_rows: 3 stated amounts: 44,000 (23 months ago), 45,000 (11 months ago), 54,000 (this application).

ssn_income_increase_20_percent_or_more_c.customer_interpretation: ssn_income_increase_20_percent_or_more: common with promotions, job changes, overtime, commission cycles. Only concerning when rapid (7-30d) with no employment change.
ssn_income_increase_20_percent_or_more_c.example_rows: Stated income rose 45,000 to 54,000 (+20%) inside the last 30 days, with no employer change recorded in that window.

ssn_multiple_apps_7d_different_incomes_c.customer_interpretation: ssn_multiple_apps_7d_different_incomes: concerning only if income differences are large (>20%) and no context explains them (e.g. coborrower apps, corrections).
ssn_multiple_apps_7d_different_incomes_c.example_rows: Only 1 application in the trailing 7 days, so no within-week income comparison exists.

ssn_stated_income_exceeds_verified_by_25.customer_interpretation: ssn_stated_income_exceeds_verified_by_25_percent: significant only when combined with conflicting employment info or repeated across applications.
ssn_stated_income_exceeds_verified_by_25.example_rows: Stated 66,000 against verified 63,400 - a 4.1% gap, inside the reporting-variance band.

ssn_income_overstatement_percentage_cont.customer_interpretation: ssn_income_overstatement_percentage: <15% is normal reporting variance. 15-25% requires context. >25% is materially suspicious.
ssn_income_overstatement_percentage_cont.example_rows: Stated 54,000 vs verified 45,800 = 18% overstatement - inside the 15-25% band the customer says 'requires context'.

loan_to_annual_income_ratio_context.customer_interpretation: loan_to_annual_income_ratio: <0.5 normal. 0.5-0.8 elevated but common for vehicle loans. >0.8 or >1.0 warrants scrutiny.
loan_to_annual_income_ratio_context.example_rows: Loan 46,000 against stated annual income 54,000 = 0.85, above the 0.8 scrutiny line.

ssn_income_high_variance_inconsistent_re.customer_interpretation: ssn_income_high_variance_inconsistent_reporting: common for self-employed, commission, seasonal, or gig workers.
ssn_income_high_variance_inconsistent_re.example_rows: Three stated amounts over 23 months, coefficient of variation 0.10. Staffing work means hours vary by assignment; weekly gross over the last 26 weeks ranged 610 to 1,240.

ssn_address_location_variations_context.customer_interpretation: ssn_address_location_variations: 1-2 normal (relocation). 3+ states in short timeframes is concerning.
ssn_address_location_variations_context.example_rows: 1 address location for this hash_ssn across all prior applications, same city and state.

has_significant_identity_inconsistency_c.customer_interpretation: has_significant_identity_inconsistency: Only concerning when corroborated by other synthetic indicators (thin file + reuse + velocity).
has_significant_identity_inconsistency_c.example_rows: Normalized first name, last name, DOB and address key match on all 3 applications for this hash_ssn.

address_ssn_count_same_building_context.customer_interpretation: address_ssn_count_same_building vs same_unit: Building-level overlap is normal in apartments. Same-unit overlap with unrelated SSNs is more concerning.
address_ssn_count_same_building_context.example_rows: 2 hash_ssn values at this building, same surname.

address_ssn_count_same_unit_context.customer_interpretation: address_ssn_count_same_building vs same_unit: Building-level overlap is normal in apartments. Same-unit overlap with unrelated SSNs is more concerning.
address_ssn_count_same_unit_context.example_rows: 2 hash_ssn values at this unit, same surname, 3 years each.

phone_ssn_count_context.customer_interpretation: phone_ssn_count: 1-2 normal (household/family). 3+ with unrelated identities warrants investigation.
phone_ssn_count_context.example_rows: 2 hash_ssn values on this normalized phone: the borrower and a household member with the same surname.

high_authorized_user_ratio_context.customer_interpretation: high_authorized_user_ratio: Common for young adults, immigrants, credit builders. Only concerning with thin file + new credit + velocity combined.
high_authorized_user_ratio_context.example_rows: 1 authorized-user tradeline out of 9 open tradelines (11%). Oldest tradeline opened 11 years ago.

is_thin_file_context.customer_interpretation: is_thin_file + very_new_file_high_score: Legitimate for young adults and new immigrants. Concerning only with multiple corroborating patterns.
is_thin_file_context.example_rows: 9 open tradelines, time in file 134 months. Credit report present and valid, so thin-file reasoning is assessable.

very_new_file_high_score_context.customer_interpretation: is_thin_file + very_new_file_high_score: Legitimate for young adults and new immigrants. Concerning only with multiple corroborating patterns.
very_new_file_high_score_context.example_rows: Time in file 134 months with a 704 score - established, not new.

older_borrower_new_credit_high_score_con.customer_interpretation: older_borrower_new_credit_high_score: Rare legitimately. More concerning than young borrower equivalent.
older_borrower_new_credit_high_score_con.example_rows: Borrower is 38 with an 11-year credit history; the file is not new for the borrower's age.

rapid_app_velocity_context.customer_interpretation: rapid_app_velocity: Common during car shopping. Only concerning with other synthetic patterns.
rapid_app_velocity_context.example_rows: 5 applications in 7 days and 9 in 30, at 6 dealers inside a 40-mile radius, all for the same vehicle class.

ssn_apps_last_7d_context.example_rows: 5 applications in the trailing 7 days at 5 different dealers, all for mid-size SUVs, requested amounts 43,000-47,000.

ssn_apps_last_30d_context.example_rows: 9 applications in the trailing 30 days at 6 dealers. Total requested exposure 398,000 against stated annual income of 54,000.

ssn_income_increased_20_percent_last_30d.example_rows: Stated income rose from 45,000 to 54,000 (+20%) within the trailing 30 days. The employer record did not change in that window and no new assignment is on file.

ssn_loan_exceeds_annual_income_unsustain.example_rows: Loan 46,000 against stated annual income 54,000 - below income on the stated figure, though only just, and above the verified figure.

ssn_loan_80_percent_or_more_annual_incom.example_rows: Loan 46,000 is 85% of stated annual income 54,000, and 100% of verified income 45,800.

employer_other_ssns_count_context.example_rows: 260 other hash_ssn values share this employer, across 78 dealers and 4 states. No address or phone clustering among them.

alerts_fired.finding_text: Nine applications in thirty days across six dealers, all for the same vehicle class, with total requested exposure of 398,000.
Requested loan amount is 85% of stated annual income and exceeds the verified income figure.
Stated income increased 20% within thirty days with no corresponding change to the employer record.
Income reported for this SSN varies between applications, consistent with assignment-based staffing hours.
Employer cited on this application appears on a high number of consortium applications; the employer is a licensed staffing agency.

overall_justification.customer_rule: MEDIUM RISK: unresolved fraud concerns supported by moderate corroborating evidence or meaningful inconsistencies requiring additional verification.

identity.customer_rule: LOW RISK: Indicators are isolated, explainable (shared household, formatting, population density, data quality), or insufficiently corroborated. LOW should be the most common outcome.

dealer.customer_rule: Do NOT escalate fraud risk classification based solely on dealer default rates or consortium scores.

straw.customer_rule: No co-borrower present: Primary straw mechanism absent. Only evaluate if other patterns (role-switching history, dealer clustering) exist.

employment.customer_rule: Large national employers, military, government, staffing agencies, and gig platforms naturally have high SSN counts — this is NOT fraud signal.

income.customer_rule: ssn_income_overstatement_percentage: <15% is normal reporting variance. 15-25% requires context. >25% is materially suspicious.

synthetic.customer_rule: LOW RISK: Indicators are isolated, explainable (thin history from youth/immigration, authorized user credit building, shared household, population density), or insufficiently corroborated. LOW should be the most common outcome.

bustout.customer_rule: Rapid application velocity, elevated utilization, and increasing loan exposure are more significant when combined with meaningful income inconsistencies, coordinated dealership activity, abnormal tradeline behavior, or conflicting borrower information.

rings.customer_rule: LOW RISK: suspicious indicators or alert activity may exist but are weak, isolated, explainable, operationally normal, contradicted by context, caused by data quality issues, or insufficiently corroborated to support material fraud concern.

notes: employment must be LOW despite 260 SSNs, 40 new in 90 days, rapid_employer_change_flag and employer_spike_flag all firing: every one of those has a staffing-agency explanation in its own _context row, and EMP-017 names staffing agencies as NOT a fraud signal.

income is POSSIBLE but income_flag is 0: 18% overstatement is in the 'requires context' band, and the context (assignment-based hours) supplies it, so MSTR-039's 'clear, material, corroborated' bar for a flag is not met.
fraud_score 712 is in the customer's high band (700-998) and the record is still MEDIUM, not HIGH - MSTR-029 reserves HIGH for multiple strongly corroborated patterns.
